notes.title: Released!
notes.notes:
Image of Perfection is now released! We're happy to bring you our creepy RPG about confronting your fears and learning to accept who you are. For it's launch week, it's 15% off.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35284385/ee96a46157f8bfd25d1f2415a8105556c211b271.png[/img]

We also are currently hosting an [url=https://crystalgameworks.weebly.com/image-of-perfection/image-of-perfection-art-contest]art contest[/url] for Image of Perfection- just draw any of the characters from the game and you'll have the chance to win Steam keys, art, and more! [url=https://crystalgameworks.weebly.com/image-of-perfection/image-of-perfection-art-contest]More info here.[/url]
